episodes.title: Payday lasted 4 seconds 💸 #shorts
episodes.logline: Pidge celebrates payday until his bills fly through the letterbox and eat it, while Sloane reveals he still has last month's pay untouched.
episodes.description: Pidge is a CEO for exactly four seconds. Flat 4B — new episode every day.

shots.keyframe: Pidge bursting through the front door holding his phone high like a trophy, glowing pile of gold coins in his other wing, Dougie cheering behind him
shots.action: Pidge spins around celebrating, Dougie claps with his tail wagging
shots.camera: low angle medium shot, quick push in

lines.t: PAYDAY! Four hundred quid! I'm basically a CEO now.

shots.keyframe: the letterbox flaps open and cartoon envelopes with tiny teeth fly in like bats toward Pidge's coin pile
shots.action: envelopes swoop around Pidge and each one bites a chunk out of his glowing coin pile, Pidge swats at them

lines.t: Rent? Phone bill? Scooter insurance? Who invited YOU?

shots.sfx: flapping paper, chomping, coins clinking away

shots.keyframe: Pidge alone in the hallway holding a single small coin, feathers ruffled, envelopes flying away out the letterbox
shots.action: Pidge stares at the coin, one feather falls slowly
shots.camera: close up on Pidge's face, slow zoom

lines.t: Fifty pence. Still a CEO. Of fifty pence.

shots.keyframe: Sloane lying on the mustard sofa slowly holding up a laptop, Pidge leaning over the back of the sofa
shots.action: Sloane turns his head extremely slowly toward Pidge

lines.t: My payday... was three weeks ago.

shots.keyframe: Pidge flat on his back on the rug, Sloane's arm slowly extending down offering a biscuit
shots.action: Pidge lifts his head hopefully toward the biscuit

episodes.loop_note: ends on Pidge on the floor; loops to him bursting in with 'PAYDAY!'

episodes.title: When your boss says 'quick call' 📞 #shorts
episodes.logline: Dougie's manager asks for a 'quick call' that lasts until nightfall and ends with booking another call about the call.
episodes.description: There is no such thing as a quick call. Flat 4B.

heron.name: Mr Heron
heron.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic tall grey heron man, thin long beak, tiny rectangular glasses, slim grey suit and skinny tie, holding a coffee cup, stands upright

shots.keyframe: Mr Heron leaning his long neck around a doorway into Dougie's desk area, Dougie looking up beaming
shots.action: Dougie jumps up eagerly, tail wagging

lines.t: Big day! Love a quick call!

shots.keyframe: inside the glass manager office, Heron talking, Dougie nodding, wall clock behind them, window showing daylight
shots.action: the clock hands spin rapidly, window shifts from day to sunset to night, Dougie slowly slumps lower in his chair

lines.t: So circling back on the circle back, let's take this offline, but online.

shots.keyframe: Dougie at night in the office, fur messy, a long grey beard has grown, a cobweb on his lanyard
shots.action: a moth flutters past Dougie's face, he blinks slowly

shots.keyframe: Heron standing up cheerfully with a calendar, Dougie frozen in his chair
shots.action: Dougie's tail stops wagging and he tips over sideways like a falling tree

lines.t: Great call. Let's book a quick call to discuss this call.

shots.keyframe: Dougie dragging himself through the flat door at midnight, Margo holding a mug in her cardigan
shots.action: Dougie collapses face-first onto the shoe pile

lines.t: I have a quick call tomorrow. About the call.

episodes.loop_note: ends at night; loops to the bright 'Quick call?' opener

episodes.title: Who keeps eating my yogurt? 🥄 #shorts
episodes.logline: Margo sets a yogurt trap for the fridge thief, catches Pidge red-handed, then discovers the real serial thief is Sloane.
episodes.hook_text: She set a trap for the fridge thief 🪤
episodes.description: Margo has a spreadsheet for this. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: Margo at the open fridge with a label maker, stickers on every item, eyes narrowed
shots.action: Margo rapidly sticks labels onto items with sharp clicks
shots.camera: medium shot from inside the fridge looking out

lines.t: Mine. Mine. Shared. Mine. Absolutely not shared.

shots.keyframe: dark kitchen at night lit only by the fridge glow, Pidge tiptoeing toward a yogurt wrapped in red warning tape
shots.action: Pidge peels off the red tape and eats the yogurt with his beak in one gulp
shots.camera: low angle, fridge light on his face

shots.keyframe: the kitchen light snaps on revealing Margo sitting at the table stroking a label maker like a villain
shots.action: Pidge freezes mid-swallow, yogurt on his beak

shots.keyframe: Margo standing with a pointer in front of the fridge, Pidge sweating
shots.action: Margo steps closer, Pidge backs into the counter

lines.t: That yogurt was bait. I've tracked the thief for six weeks.
Six weeks? I moved in five weeks ago!

shots.keyframe: Sloane standing in the kitchen doorway in his beanie, holding a stack of six empty yogurt pots
shots.action: Margo and Pidge turn their heads slowly to Sloane, who slowly raises one empty pot

episodes.loop_note: ends on the yogurt stack; loops to Margo labelling the fridge

episodes.title: Day 1 at the gym be like 💪 #shorts
episodes.logline: Dougie's first gym session lasts four minutes after a treadmill launches him, but he still posts it as a personal best.
episodes.hook_text: Day one of the new me 💪
episodes.description: No pain, no gain. Mostly pain. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: Dougie in brand-new neon gym gear holding his phone up for a selfie, flexing a tiny bicep
shots.action: Dougie poses, flexes, winks at the camera

lines.t: Day one of the new me! Big day, big day!

shots.keyframe: Dougie on a treadmill jabbing the speed button, Pidge leaning on the next treadmill eating chips
shots.action: the treadmill speeds up wildly and launches Dougie backwards off the end

lines.t: Mate, that's the speed setting for horses.

shots.keyframe: Dougie upside down on the floor tangled in a resistance band, phone stuck to his forehead
shots.action: Dougie wiggles, Pidge peels the phone off his face

lines.t: Your phone. You pulled your phone.

shots.keyframe: Dougie on the sofa with an ice pack on his head typing on his phone, Margo reading a book next to him
shots.action: Dougie types proudly, Margo peers at his screen over her glasses

lines.t: Absolutely crushed it today. No pain, no gain.
You were there for four minutes.

shots.keyframe: close on Dougie's face, determined, ice pack sliding off
shots.action: his tail wags weakly and knocks the ice pack off the sofa
shots.sfx: ice pack plop, triumphant brass sting

episodes.loop_note: ends on Dougie's pride; loops to the selfie

episodes.title: The calmest freelancer alive 🦥 #shorts
episodes.logline: The flat panics over Sloane's five-minute deadline, only to learn he submitted the work weeks ago and the deadline is his nap.
episodes.description: Sloane does not panic. Sloane has never panicked. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: Margo bursting into the living room pointing at the clock, Sloane lying on the sofa
shots.action: Sloane begins to turn his head extremely slowly

lines.t: Sloane! Your deadline is in five minutes!

shots.keyframe: Pidge hammering a keyboard, Dougie frantically fanning the laptop with a cushion
shots.action: both run in circles around the coffee table in a panic

lines.t: Just type words! Any words! Clients love words!

shots.keyframe: Sloane's arm slowly extending toward the laptop, Margo holding a stopwatch
shots.action: Sloane's hand moves inch by inch, the stopwatch ticks
shots.camera: extreme close up on Sloane's slow claw, cut to Margo

shots.keyframe: Sloane holding the laptop calmly, everyone frozen around him mid-panic
shots.action: everyone freezes, Dougie's ears flop

lines.t: I submitted it... three weeks ago.
Then what's due in five minutes?

shots.keyframe: Sloane closing his eyes on the sofa, Margo with an open laptop spreadsheet
shots.action: Sloane instantly falls asleep mid-word and snores, Margo types it in

episodes.loop_note: ends on snoring Sloane; loops to Margo bursting in

episodes.title: Landlord inspection in 60 seconds 😱 #shorts
episodes.logline: The flatmates cram all their mess into one cupboard before an inspection, but the landlady refuses to open it because her own 1987 mess is in there too.
episodes.description: Rule number forty-seven: never open that cupboard. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: Mrs Badger at the top of the stairs pressing an intercom button, clipboard under her arm
shots.action: she checks her watch and smirks
shots.camera: low angle looking up the stairs

shots.keyframe: messy living room, all four flatmates flinging clothes, pizza boxes and mugs into one tall cupboard
shots.action: speed-clean montage; Pidge sits against the cupboard door to force it shut

lines.t: Everything in the cupboard! Including your feelings!

shots.keyframe: spotless living room, flatmates standing in a stiff line, Mrs Badger running a gloved finger along a shelf
shots.action: she inspects her clean glove and narrows her eyes
shots.camera: close up on the glove, rack focus to her face

shots.keyframe: Mrs Badger's paw on the cupboard handle, flatmates gasping behind her
shots.action: she opens the door an inch, peeks inside, then slams it shut, sweating

lines.t: That cupboard is not part of the inspection.

shots.keyframe: Mrs Badger marching briskly out the front door, Margo staring after her
shots.action: Mrs Badger stamps the clipboard and hurries out

lines.t: Because that's where I hid MY mess. In 1987. Passed!

episodes.loop_note: ends with door slam; loops to the intercom buzz

episodes.title: My flatmates rewrote my dating profile 💘 #shorts
episodes.logline: Margo's flatmates sabotage her brutally honest dating bio, but the only word left gets her a perfect silent match.
episodes.hook_text: Her dating bio was TOO honest
episodes.description: Some people want sparks. Margo wants silence. Flat 4B.

owen.name: Owen
owen.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic tawny owl man in his thirties, large calm amber eyes, black turtleneck jumper, holding a teacup, stands upright

shots.keyframe: Margo on the sofa typing on her phone, Dougie reading over her shoulder with horror
shots.action: Dougie gasps and covers his mouth

lines.t: Bio: I enjoy silence and accurate receipts.

shots.keyframe: Dougie and Pidge wrestling over Margo's phone above her head
shots.action: they pass the phone back and forth typing

shots.keyframe: Sloane holding the phone, one claw slowly pressing the screen, Margo watching
shots.action: Sloane slowly hands the phone back to Margo

lines.t: You deleted everything except the word silence.

shots.keyframe: Margo's phone lighting up with a heart-shaped notification glow on her face
shots.action: Margo raises one eyebrow, her tail flicks

lines.t: A match. His whole message says: 'Same.'

shots.keyframe: Margo and Owen the owl sitting across a cafe table, both holding teacups, perfectly content, no talking
shots.action: they sip tea in total silence, then both nod with satisfaction

episodes.loop_note: ends in calm silence; loops to the bio typing

episodes.title: Me hitting snooze 'just 5 more minutes' ⏰ #shorts
episodes.logline: Dougie snoozes his alarm into chaos and sprints to work in the rain before learning it's Saturday.
episodes.description: The snooze button is a liar. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: Dougie in bed with a sleep mask on his forehead, slapping a ringing alarm clock
shots.action: he hits snooze and pulls the duvet over his head

lines.t: Five more minutes. Big day... later.

shots.keyframe: same bed, Dougie in a different tangled sleeping pose, sunlight brighter
shots.action: jump cuts of the alarm ringing and Dougie slapping it, light changing each time, his fur getting wilder

lines.t: Five more. Five more. Okay, three more.

shots.keyframe: Dougie bolt upright in bed, eyes huge, bright noon sun blasting through the blinds
shots.action: he leaps out of bed and gets tangled in the duvet

shots.keyframe: Dougie sprinting down a rainy street, shirt half-buttoned, toast in his mouth, lanyard flying; Pidge on a scooter alongside
shots.action: Dougie runs through puddles, Pidge cruises next to him easily

shots.keyframe: Dougie stopped dead in the pouring rain, soaked, toast drooping; Pidge under a tiny umbrella
shots.action: the toast slowly falls from Dougie's mouth into a puddle

episodes.title: Splitting the bill with THAT friend 🧾 #shorts
episodes.logline: Margo splits a restaurant bill to the penny while broke Pidge argues his breadstick, until Sloane reveals an eleven-year loyalty card already covered everything.
episodes.hook_text: Splitting the bill... to the penny 🧾
episodes.description: Every friend group has a calculator. Flat 4B.

gerald.name: Gerald
gerald.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic emperor penguin waiter, natural tuxedo plumage, white napkin over one flipper, small silver tray, very upright posture

shots.keyframe: a tiny silver bill tray on the table, Margo pulling a large calculator from her cardigan
shots.action: Margo cracks her knuckles and starts typing
shots.camera: close up on calculator, tilt up to Margo

lines.t: I'll split it. Fairly. To the penny.

shots.keyframe: Pidge holding up a single breadstick defensively, Margo typing
shots.action: Pidge waves the breadstick, Margo keeps typing without looking up

lines.t: I only had tap water and one breadstick!
Breadstick, ninety pence. Emotional support from Dougie, extra.

shots.keyframe: Dougie standing up heroically, opening his wallet
shots.action: a moth flutters out of the empty wallet, Dougie sits back down slowly
shots.camera: low hero angle, then deflating wide

lines.t: I'll pay for everyone! Big day! ...Smaller day.

shots.sfx: heroic chord, moth flutter, deflating whistle

shots.keyframe: Gerald the penguin waiter bowing at the table, picking up the tray
shots.action: Gerald bows, Margo freezes mid-calculation

lines.t: The bill has been settled, madam.

shots.keyframe: everyone turning to Sloane, who slowly holds up a battered, very long loyalty card
shots.action: the loyalty card unfolds down to the floor like a scroll

lines.t: Loyalty card. I've eaten here... every day... for eleven years.

episodes.loop_note: loops to the bill tray arriving

episodes.title: My flatmate's newest 'business idea' 🍞 #shorts
episodes.logline: Pidge tries to sell an 'exclusive certified' slice of bread and ends up trading it to the landlady for a whole loaf.
episodes.hook_text: He's selling ONE slice of bread 🍞
episodes.description: It's not a scam, it's a business model. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: a single slice of bread on a velvet cushion on a pedestal under a spotlight, Pidge in a blazer over his hi-vis presenting it
shots.action: Pidge sweeps his wing toward the bread

lines.t: Ladies and gents. Exclusive. Digital. Bread.

shots.keyframe: Margo staring flatly at the bread, Pidge unrolling a fancy golden scroll certificate
shots.action: the certificate unrolls with a flourish

lines.t: It's a slice of bread with a certificate.

shots.keyframe: Pidge at Mrs Badger's door holding the bread on its cushion, Mrs Badger in curlers squinting
shots.action: Pidge pitches, Mrs Badger leans closer and sniffs the bread

lines.t: One of a kind. Limited edition. Fifty quid.

shots.keyframe: Mrs Badger holding out a whole fresh loaf of bread
shots.action: she swaps the loaf for the slice and shuts the door

shots.keyframe: Pidge holding the whole loaf triumphantly above his head, Margo with a calculator
shots.action: Margo checks the calculator, her eyes widen

lines.t: One slice into twenty slices. Nineteen hundred percent return.

episodes.loop_note: loops to the bread on the pedestal

episodes.title: The thermostat war in every home 🌡️ #shorts
episodes.logline: Margo and Dougie wage a secret night-time war over the thermostat until they break it and learn the landlady has controlled the heat all along.
episodes.description: Every flat has a thermostat war. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: Margo turning a round thermostat dial on the hallway wall down, wrapped in a blanket
shots.action: she turns the dial with precision and nods
shots.camera: close up on the dial then Margo

shots.keyframe: Dougie tiptoeing to the thermostat in a fluffy dressing gown
shots.action: he cranks the dial up with a grin

shots.keyframe: dark hallway at night, Margo in a black ninja outfit creeping on the ceiling, Dougie disguised as a houseplant
shots.action: montage of them sneaking past each other to the dial in increasingly absurd disguises

shots.keyframe: Margo and Dougie both gripping the thermostat dial, face to face, nose to nose
shots.action: they both twist hard, the dial snaps off in their paws
shots.camera: tight two-shot, then snap zoom on the broken dial

shots.keyframe: Mrs Badger upstairs in an armchair in her dressing gown, holding a remote control, sipping tea
shots.action: she presses a button on the remote and smiles

lines.t: That dial downstairs hasn't worked since 2004.

episodes.loop_note: loops to Margo at the dial

episodes.title: Workaholic on her first holiday 🏖️ #shorts
episodes.logline: Margo can't stop working on her first holiday in six years, then discovers her boss secretly working on the next deckchair.
episodes.description: Out of office. Not out of the office. Flat 4B.

heron.name: Mr Heron
heron.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic tall grey heron man, thin long beak, tiny rectangular glasses, slim grey suit and skinny tie, holding a coffee cup, stands upright

shots.keyframe: Margo on a deckchair in a sunhat and her cardigan, laptop on her knees
shots.action: Margo types while waves roll behind her

lines.t: First holiday in six years. I am relaxing.

shots.keyframe: Dougie in an inflatable duck ring peering at Margo's laptop
shots.action: Margo types even faster without looking up

shots.keyframe: Dougie burying the laptop in the sand, Margo calmly pulling a second laptop from her beach bag
shots.action: Margo opens the second laptop and continues

shots.keyframe: close on Margo's face lit by the laptop screen, an email notification glow
shots.action: her eyes widen behind her sunglasses

lines.t: My boss just replied. From... a beach.

shots.keyframe: camera pans to the very next deckchair: Mr Heron, sunburnt, typing on a laptop
shots.action: they lock eyes, then both slowly close their laptops in unison
shots.sfx: two laptops closing in sync, seagull laugh

episodes.loop_note: loops to Margo opening her laptop

episodes.title: Meal prep Sunday vs. my flatmate 🍱 #shorts
episodes.logline: Dougie meal-preps twenty-one lunches for the week and wakes up Monday to find Pidge ate twenty of them overnight.
episodes.description: Meal prep only works if you live alone. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: Dougie in an apron surrounded by a tower of identical lunch boxes stacked to the ceiling
shots.action: Dougie places the last box on top proudly

lines.t: Twenty-one meals. I'm a proper adult now.

shots.keyframe: Monday morning, Dougie opening the fridge, an empty fridge except one lunch box
shots.action: Dougie's jaw drops, he looks left and right

lines.t: Who eats twenty meals in one night?!

shots.keyframe: Pidge at the kitchen table with a perfectly round belly, crumbs on his beak, stack of empty boxes beside him
shots.action: Pidge slowly finishes chewing

shots.keyframe: Pidge explaining with wing gestures, Dougie's eye twitching
shots.action: Pidge leans back in the chair, Dougie's eyelid twitches

lines.t: Technically I ate your future meals. So I'm a time traveller.

shots.keyframe: Dougie opening the last lunch box with hope
shots.action: inside the box is one single pea; Dougie stares at it
shots.camera: top-down into the box, then Dougie's face

lines.t: I saved you the best one.

episodes.loop_note: loops to the lunch box tower

episodes.title: Delivering a parcel to my own flat 📦 #shorts
episodes.logline: Delivery rider Pidge discovers his parcel is for his own flat, gets locked out, and waits an eternity for Sloane to open the door.
episodes.hook_text: The delivery address was HIS flat 📦

shots.keyframe: Pidge on his scooter holding a parcel, checking his phone in the rain
shots.action: he zooms off with a grin

shots.keyframe: Pidge outside the 4B front door holding the parcel, realising
shots.action: he pats his vest pockets looking for keys, finds nothing

lines.t: Hold on. That's MY flat. Where are my keys?

shots.keyframe: Sloane lying on the sofa hearing the buzzer, starting to sit up
shots.action: Sloane rises... extremely... slowly

shots.keyframe: Pidge waiting at the door, parcel in his wings
shots.action: time-lapse: daylight changes, other pigeons gather and sit around him, a spider web forms on his cap

lines.t: Any day now, mate! I've got forty more drops!

shots.keyframe: door finally open, Sloane holding the opened parcel, revealing a brand new doorbell
shots.action: Sloane holds up the doorbell, Pidge face-palms with his wing

episodes.loop_note: doorbell ding loops to the scooter start

episodes.title: Too honest in a job interview 👔 #shorts
episodes.logline: Dougie accidentally tells an interviewer he wants her chair in five years, and she hands it to him on the spot.
episodes.hook_text: "Where do you see yourself in 5 years?"
episodes.description: Honesty: the ultimate interview hack? Flat 4B.

ms_goose.name: Ms Goose
ms_goose.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic white goose woman, sharp orange beak, stern eyes, pearl necklace, navy blazer, reading glasses on a chain, stands upright

shots.keyframe: Dougie in an oversized suit sitting across a desk from Ms Goose, his tail wagging under the chair
shots.action: Dougie waves too enthusiastically, then corrects himself

lines.t: Big day! I mean... hello. Good afternoon.

shots.keyframe: Ms Goose peering over her glasses holding a clipboard
shots.action: she taps her pen, Dougie answers before thinking

lines.t: Where do you see yourself in five years?

shots.keyframe: close up on Dougie frozen, tail stopped mid-wag
shots.action: his eyes slowly widen in horror

shots.keyframe: Ms Goose standing up slowly, removing her glasses dramatically
shots.action: she stands, pushes her big leather chair toward Dougie

lines.t: Finally. Someone honest. I resign tomorrow. The chair is yours.

shots.keyframe: Dougie sitting in the big leather chair, spinning with joy
shots.action: he spins so fast the chair rolls out of the office door and down the corridor
